notes.title: Super Cave Boy goes Steam Deck
notes.content:
Hi folks,

this thread is for sharing and discussing your experience running Super Cave Boy on your steam deck.

We have already run it with a few testers on a steamdeck and all have shared positive feedback with us so far so we are excited to see your thoughts about this!

notes.title: Bugfixes and Stability - Make cave boy great again
notes.content:
Hello boys and girls,

we added a new patch (1.0.2) for super cave boy to be even more super. These include the following:

- Fixed a bug where controllers with slight stick drift would cause the left and right input to be neutralized
- Improved checks for legal put locations
- Fixed some errors that might happen on startup
